target_profile.system_boundary: Captured OmniPaxos Rust core library with generic storage and caller-driven transport/ticks; repository storage and async runtime remain within audit boundary, with deeper variants explicitly open.
ownership: Core methods serialize mutation through &mut self; application owns network delivery and application of decisions.

activities.realization_summary: Promise quorum selects inherited sequence; acceptance quorum advances decided boundary; sequenced messages propagate it.

activities.realization_summary: BLE or manual attempt nominates higher ballot; durable promises and role/phase/sequence guards constrain eligible work.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Stored promises, reconnect notification and sequence gaps initiate preparation/synchronization; tick drives retries.
Cluster configuration determines peers/quorums; decided StopSign seals old log and caller starts next instance.
Synchronous reads expose decided entries or compacted snapshots; application applies them externally.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion

implementation_guards: BLE replies require current heartbeat round and matching configuration; SequencePaxos handle_leader requires a ballot above both current leader state and promise.
writes: BLE leader, happiness, ballot; accepted election initializes fresh leader bookkeeping and persists own promise.
external_effects: Heartbeat requests/replies; election invokes SequencePaxos preparation.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Election alone does not decide; leader must gather prepare support then synchronize accepted history.

unknowns: BLE reply vector does not deduplicate by peer; transport duplication applicability remains unread.

implementation_guards: Prepare requires a higher ballot or equal ballot in Recover.
Promise consumption requires Leader role and matching leader ballot.
writes: Flush batches before changing promise; follower resets sequence and caches Promise; new leader resets LeaderState; PrepareReq resets peer promise and outgoing accept metadata; NotAccepted marks peer PromisedHigher.
durable_effects: Storage promise update precedes outgoing Promise.
external_effects: Prepare and Promise contain accepted round/index and decided index; Promise optionally carries log synchronization.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Promise quorum chooses accepted history by accepted ballot then length; old ballot replies cannot enter a new leader ballot.

existing_protections: Per-peer promise slots prevent duplicate Promise messages from increasing quorum count.
unknowns: Configuration isolation at transport/instance replacement boundaries remains unverified; ballot ordering omits config_id although equality includes it.

implementation_guards: Matching ballot and prepare quorum counted from per-peer promise slots.

writes: sync_log selects inherited history, appends buffered proposals unless stopped, enters Accept, records own accepted index.
external_effects: AcceptSync sent to promised followers with a new per-peer sequence session.

cross_activity_effects.A2: New authority is constrained by inherited support, not only by BLE nomination.

behaviors.trigger: append, AcceptDecide, Accepted, Decide, flush timeout
implementation_guards: Leader accepts proposals only before StopSign. Follower requires promised ballot and correct phase; sequenced messages require the next sequence number.
Accepted requires current leader ballot and Leader/Accept; chosen index requires configured write quorum of per-peer indexes.
writes: Persist flushed entries; record accepted indexes; advance decided index after quorum; follower bounds received decided index by flushed accepted length.
external_effects: AcceptDecide, Accepted, Decide messages; queued messages may be coalesced.
async_boundaries: Caller drains outgoing messages and delivers them; drain resets message-cache offsets.

facts.meaning: This replica records a promised ballot; follower acceptance compares incoming ballot to this promise, with phase and sequence guards applied separately.
facts.validity_context: Current stored/cached promise within a running instance; this is not proof of quorum leadership.
facts.durability: Backend promise persists across reconstruction if backend is durable; memory backend does not survive process loss.
facts.recovery: Stored promise starts in Recover and requests prepare.

facts.meaning: Locally stored accepted log prefix, optional compacted representation and StopSign, with accepted round and logical accepted length; batched unflushed entries are excluded.
facts.validity_context: Accepted round and local storage state; undecided suffix can be replaced by sync.
facts.durability: Depends on backend; synchronization requires atomic operations; in-memory batching is not accepted storage.
facts.recovery: load_cache restores metadata and derives length from backend; synchronization selects inherited suffix.

facts.meaning: The local decided index classifies preceding log entries as decided; it records a boundary rather than independently verifying content.
facts.validity_context: Current stored history and local decided boundary.
facts.durability: Backend dependent; quorum decisions persist index, synchronization installs index with history atomically.
facts.recovery: Loaded from backend and propagated by Promise/AcceptSync/Decide.

facts.meaning: A stored snapshot is paired with a compacted boundary and returned as the representation of the compacted prefix; construction uses Snapshot::create and merge on selected local entries and received deltas.
facts.validity_context: Local snapshot and compacted boundary after successful storage operation; content correspondence remains a responsibility to investigate.
facts.durability: Snapshot and compaction metadata are installed together through Storage::write_atomically; durability depends on backend.
facts.recovery: Complete synchronization replaces snapshot; Delta reconstructs local snapshot and merges incoming changes; load_cache restores boundary.

surfaces.reason: New decided boundary precedes local base construction; first candidate investigates delta/base alignment.
Core dispatch passes SequencePaxos messages without visible configuration filter. Need caller/runtime routing and legal transition history before attributing responsibility.
In-repository actor completion APIs and inbound processing are not yet traced; not externalized merely because transport is caller owned.
Accepted indexes remain when promise is lost; determine whether this is valid historical support or whether any legal continuation misuses it.

formation.explanation: Caller append buffers during Prepare or forwards to promised leader. Prepare quorum selects highest accepted round/length history; leader syncs it, preserves maximum reported decision boundary, appends pending work when not stopped, and sends AcceptSync. Accept-phase follower validates ballot, phase and sequence, persists entries and acknowledges accepted length. Leader stores one accepted index per pid and decides on configured write quorum, propagating Decide or piggybacking AcceptDecide. Reads classify entries by local decided index; application polls and consumes them.

context.explanation: BLE heartbeat rounds assess connectivity/happiness and propose ballots; manual attempt increments a ballot directly. SequencePaxos requires higher ballot before leader preparation and resets leader support. Higher Prepare flushes follower batches, persists promise, resets sequence and emits Promise. Lower-ballot accepts are rejected with NotAccepted; unseen higher accepts initiate recovery. New or recovered instances with stored promise enter Recover; equal-ballot Prepare is allowed there. Reconnect/gaps request prepare; ticks resend preparation and StopSign work. Configuration transition uses decided StopSign then caller constructs a fresh instance.

connection.explanation: Authority acquisition reads prior accepted history before creating new support: Promise metadata and optional log synchronization carry old accepted rounds and decisions into prepare quorum selection. AcceptSync reestablishes participation under a new ballot/session; old-ballot replies are excluded, old sequences ignored and gaps resynchronize. Stored decisions constrain selected history through maximum reported decided index; suffix/snapshot reconstruction must preserve its meaning. Pending leader proposals are appended after sync unless StopSign seals the log; followers forward buffered ordinary proposals after sync. Persistence and Snapshot traits supply history, while caller transport/ticks drive asynchronous propagation.

open_details: Delta snapshot base alignment is the first sourced discrepancy.
Configuration isolation and pending StopSign forwarding need deeper transition analysis.
Persistent backend failure behavior, async actor completion and feature-specific unicache branches remain open.
core_overview.rationale: Both core paths and their storage, recovery, configuration and consumption connection are traced through concrete callers and guards; local anomalies and unread variants do not assert correctness.
